tracks.title: Son Of Mirror Man - Mere Man

verdict.detail: The same year as the first issue (US, BTS 1, 1968).

cutters: Lacquer Cut at Philips Records Ltd.

notes.text:
Original UK stereo release in matt gatefold cover.
Blue Liberty labels without matrix number in parentheses below side identification; this is added on all other blue label releases.
This album has a 'Unipak'-style gatefold cover [however, disc access from the outside] with only one card layer for the front flap.
First catalogue number on cover spine and labels, 2nd on cover rear bottom right. 

Recorded April 25 through May 2, 1968 at Sunset Sound, Hollywood, Calif.

℗ 1968

Liberty Records Limited London W1
